Visit note | 2025-05-13 10:00 AM | Dr. Zahid Hasan, Gastroenterology | Patient: Jahid Kabir, 74, male. Mr. Kabir presents today complaining of vomiting, painful belly cramps, and loose watery stools. He reports that these troubles started after drinking tap water on a trip to Tejgaon. He works as a shopkeeper and lives with his family in Dhaka. He has a known history of Bronchial asthma. He denies chest pain, dizziness at rest, or difficulty breathing today. On examination, his pulse is 111 bpm, BP reads 114/77 mmHg, and his weight is 69 kg. His abdomen is soft with mild tenderness around the navel, and chest auscultation reveals clear breath sounds with no wheeze. Assessment: Acute gastroenteritis. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to drink small sips of fluid often, eat bland items like rice, bananas, and toast, and wash his hands thoroughly before eating. Follow-up in 2 days if the stools do not settle.

Visit note | 2025-05-13 10:00 AM | Dr. Mehedi Hasan, Ophthalmology | Patient: Nazma Awal, 23, female. Ms. Awal attends the clinic with itchy, watery, red eyes affecting both sides, noting that her symptoms tend to get worse in certain seasons. She states this flare began after visiting a farm in Uttara. She works as a hotel receptionist. She has Essential hypertension. She reports no vision loss, severe eye pain, or discharge that seals her eyelids in the morning. On examination, visual acuity is 6/9 in the right eye, BP is 150/92 mmHg, and pulse is 70 bpm with a weight of 49 kg. Examination of the eyes shows bilateral conjunctival injection with mild papillary reaction, clear corneas, and reactive pupils. Assessment: Allergic conjunctivitis. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to avoid rubbing her eyes, apply cool compresses to ease irritation, and wear sunglasses outdoors. Follow-up in 2 weeks.

Visit note | 2025-05-13 10:30 AM | Dr. Sadia Islam, Dermatology | Patient: Uttam Roy, 51, male. Mr. Roy returns for a review of his skin, reporting itchy dry patches on his elbows and knees that cause intense scratching at night and are noticeably worse in winter. He mentions that his condition flared during the dry winter in Khilgaon. He works as a nurse. He has a history of Bronchial asthma. He denies weeping lesions, secondary bacterial infection, or recent changes in soap or detergent. On examination, the affected area is about 4 cm across over both elbows and knees showing lichenified erythematous plaques, with BP 120/75 mmHg, pulse 75 bpm, and weight 65 kg. Assessment: Atopic eczema. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to use a mild soap, avoid hot baths which dry out the skin, and wear soft cotton clothes. Follow-up in 2 weeks.

Visit note | 2025-05-13 02:00 PM | Dr. Tanvir Ahmed, General Medicine | Patient: Mehedi Mahmud, 44, male. Mr. Mahmud comes in for a follow-up visit, reporting that he keeps getting breathless on the stairs and has noticed brittle nails. He mentions these issues were noticed after months of skipping lunch during long shifts in Uttara. He works as an office cleaner. He has no other major comorbidity. He denies chest pain, palpitations, or blackouts. On examination, haemoglobin is 9.8 g/dL, BP is 121/85 mmHg, pulse is 81 bpm, and weight is 63 kg. He appears pale with spooning of the fingernails; his heart sounds are normal and chest is clear. Assessment: Iron deficiency anaemia. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to eat more lentils, spinach, liver, and eggs, and to avoid drinking tea within an hour of meals. Follow-up in 6 weeks with a repeat haemoglobin test.

Visit note | 2025-05-13 02:00 PM | Dr. Saiful Alam, Endocrinology | Patient: Zakia Mondal, 38, female. Mrs. Mondal attends for a follow-up consultation, stating she experiences shaky hands, is losing weight despite eating well, and feels a racing heart. She shares that her symptoms began after a stressful family event in Khilgaon. She works as a homemaker. She has no chronic comorbidity. She denies heat intolerance, visual disturbances, or leg swelling. On examination, her pulse is 110 bpm, BP is 128/70 mmHg, and weight is 71 kg. Her thyroid gland is diffusely enlarged and smooth, and her reflexes are brisk. Assessment: Hyperthyroidism. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to avoid excess tea and coffee, and to rest whenever her heart races. Follow-up in 4 weeks with thyroid function tests.

Visit note | 2025-05-13 02:00 PM | Dr. Faisal Karim, Psychiatry | Patient: Krishna Bose, 71, female. She appears fatigued but alert and oriented. Assessment: Chronic insomnia. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to keep fixed sleep and wake times, avoid screens for an hour before bed, and avoid tea after 4 PM. Follow-up in 4 weeks with a sleep diary.
